headline: Just Dial Q2 profit drops 10% on margin contraction
hook: Profit and margins shrink at Just Dial
summary: Just Dial reported a 9.73% year-on-year decline in consolidated net profit to ₹107.8 crore for the second quarter of FY27. The company's Ebitda margin contracted by 228 basis points to 26.4%. Shares fell 6% following the release of these results.
why_it_matters: Weak earnings performance triggers immediate sell-off in Just Dial shares

headline: Infosys shares rise 2 percent following Truist collaboration as Sobha, SML Mahindra, and Just Dial decline
hook: Truist tie-up lifts Infosys while peers slide
summary: Infosys shares gained 2 percent following a new collaboration with Truist, while mid-cap and small-cap stocks like Sobha, SML Mahindra, and Just Dial dropped between 3 and 8 percent. The divergence highlights selective buying in frontline IT stocks amid weakness in other sectors. Retail investors tracking momentum must distinguish stock-specific gains from broader market trends.
why_it_matters: IT majors find support while selective mid-caps face selling pressure.
winners_losers: Infosys gains / Sobha and SML Mahindra hurt

headline: Earnings season continues with major companies reporting Q2 results
hook: Heavy day for Q2 earnings reports
summary: Multiple companies including Adani Green Energy, Indian Hotels, M&M Finance, and SRF are scheduled to release their second-quarter financial results today. Investors are tracking these filings to gauge sector-specific performance and margin trends. These reports provide critical data on corporate health across the hospitality, renewable energy, and financial services sectors.
whats_next: Earnings filings to be released throughout the trading day.
why_it_matters: Stock prices for these companies will react to earnings surprises.

headline: CCPA cracks down on seven online platforms for listing explosives
hook: Hazardous chemicals removed from major digital marketplaces
summary: The Central Consumer Protection Authority has taken action against seven online marketplaces, including IndiaMART and TradeIndia, for listing hazardous explosive materials like ammonium nitrate and PETN. A total of 3,940 sellers have been delisted following the crackdown. The move aims to curb illegal and unregulated online sales of dangerous chemicals. Indian retail investors with exposure to these B2B platform stocks should monitor potential regulatory tightening on compliance.
why_it_matters: Stricter platform compliance may raise operational costs for B2B marketplaces.
winners_losers: Compliant marketplaces gain / unregulated sellers hurt

headline: CCPA books IndiaMART and Justdial over explosive products listings
hook: Consumer protection watchdog targets local listing platforms
summary: The Central Consumer Protection Authority has initiated regulatory action against seven ecommerce platforms, including IndiaMART and Justdial, for listing hazardous and explosive products. The action addresses consumer safety violations related to unauthorized sales of dangerous items on digital marketplaces. Indian retail investors should monitor regulatory developments as compliance scrutiny intensifies for online B2B and classified platforms.
whats_next: CCPA formal adjudication and platform responses
why_it_matters: Stricter platform compliance may increase operational costs for online marketplaces
winners_losers: Compliant platforms gain / listed platforms probed hurt

headline: Anand Rathi analyst identifies short-term stock picks
hook: Technical setups signal potential short-term gains
summary: Analyst Jigar S. Patel of Anand Rathi has issued short-term buy recommendations for Just Dial, Orient Hotels, and BSE. The recommendations are based on technical chart analysis rather than fundamental performance. The analyst advises investors to avoid panic selling and instead look for buying opportunities during market dips. These picks include specific target prices and stop-loss levels for risk management.
why_it_matters: Technical levels provide entry and exit points for short-term traders.

headline: Just Dial updates contact details of key managerial personnel
hook: Routine disclosure of key personnel contact details
summary: Just Dial Limited has formally notified the stock exchange regarding the contact details of its key managerial personnel. This disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 30(5) of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The filing is procedural and has no direct financial impact on the company's operations or earnings. Indian retail investors are unaffected by this routine administrative update.
why_it_matters: No financial impact on your investments.

headline: Just Dial reports Q2 revenue up 13% to ₹343 crore
hook: Revenue growth boosts Just Dial profits
summary: Just Dial's Q2 revenue rose over 13% year-on-year to ₹343 crore. EBITDA increased 4.5% to ₹91 crore compared with ₹87.1 crore a year earlier. Net profit for the quarter stood at ₹108 crore. The results reflect steady growth in the company's local search and advertising business.
why_it_matters: Just Dial's profit rise may lift its stock price

headline: Just Dial releases financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
summary: Just Dial Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. Retail investors can review these filings on the exchange website to assess the company's recent quarterly performance and revenue trends. The regulatory filing provides updated financials for stakeholders tracking the company's operational progress. These periodic disclosures help market participants evaluate the firm's financial health.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reveal recent operational performance.

headline: Just Dial shares jump 13% on heavy trading volume
hook: Massive volume surge triggers sharp intraday rally
summary: Just Dial shares surged 12.6% to reach an intraday high of ₹802, opening at ₹716.45 compared to the previous close of ₹712.45. The sharp price movement was accompanied by trading volumes soaring 115 times the normal level. Market analysts are currently examining whether this sudden surge signals further gains or an isolated trading anomaly. Retail investors holding the stock should monitor subsequent volume trends to confirm momentum.
why_it_matters: Sudden volume spikes in Just Dial signal potential short-term volatility.
winners_losers: Just Dial shareholders gain / short sellers hurt

headline: V.S.S. Mani submits SEBI takeover exemption disclosure for Just Dial shares
hook: Promoter acquisition filing at Just Dial
summary: Promoter V.S.S. Mani has filed a regulatory disclosure regarding share acquisitions made under exemptions provided in SEBI Takeover Regulations. The filing complies with Regulation 10(6) reporting requirements for stock exchanges. Such disclosures provide transparency on internal promoter stake movements. Indian retail investors tracking Just Dial can note routine promoter holding updates.
why_it_matters: Routine promoter stake filing with no immediate impact on share price.
